quiz.question_zh: 北极熊和企鹅能住在一起吗？
quiz.question_en: Can polar bears and penguins live together?
quiz.explain_zh: 北极熊住在北极，企鹅住在南极，它们相隔整个地球。
quiz.explain_en: Polar bears live in the Arctic, penguins in the Antarctic.

quiz.question_en: Are there polar bears in Antarctica?
quiz.explain_zh: 南极没有北极熊，北极没有企鹅，这是最常见的极地误区。
quiz.explain_en: No polar bears in Antarctica, no penguins in the Arctic.

quiz.question_zh: 哪种鸟每年从北极飞到南极再飞回来？
quiz.question_en: Which bird migrates from the Arctic to the Antarctic every year?
quiz.explain_zh: 北极燕鸥是迁徙距离最长的动物，一年能飞几万公里。
quiz.explain_en: The Arctic Tern makes the longest migration of any animal.

quiz.question_zh: 南极生态链的基石是什么？
quiz.question_en: What is the foundation of the Antarctic food chain?
quiz.explain_zh: 鲸鱼、企鹅、海豹都吃南极磷虾，它是整个南极生态的核心。
quiz.explain_en: Whales, penguins and seals all feed on Antarctic krill.

quiz.question_zh: 北极地区有，南极地区没有的动物是？
quiz.question_en: Which animal lives in the Arctic but not the Antarctic?
quiz.explain_zh: 北极熊只在北极，是北极的顶级掠食者。
quiz.explain_en: Polar bears are exclusive to the Arctic.

quiz.question_zh: 世界上最大的动物是什么？
quiz.question_en: What is the largest animal in the world?
quiz.explain_zh: 蓝鲸生活在海洋里，比任何恐龙都大。
quiz.explain_en: The blue whale is larger than any dinosaur.

quiz.question_zh: 世界上最大的鱼是什么？
quiz.question_en: What is the largest fish in the world?
quiz.explain_zh: 鲸鲨虽然叫“鲸”，但它是鱼，只吃浮游生物。
quiz.explain_en: Despite its name, the whale shark is a fish that eats plankton.

quiz.question_zh: 什么动物被称为“活化石”，曾被认为已经灭绝？
quiz.question_en: Which animal is called a living fossil and was once thought extinct?
quiz.explain_zh: 腔棘鱼在印度洋被发现，是几千万年前就存在的古老鱼类。
quiz.explain_en: The coelacanth was rediscovered in the Indian Ocean.

quiz.question_zh: 被称为“海牛”，也是美人鱼传说的原型之一的是？
quiz.question_en: Which animal is called a sea cow and inspired mermaid legends?
quiz.explain_zh: 儒艮生活在印度洋，吃海草，是温和的海洋哺乳动物。
quiz.explain_en: The dugong lives in the Indian Ocean and feeds on seagrass.

quiz.explain_zh: 珊瑚是动物，由很多微小的珊瑚虫组成。
quiz.explain_en: Corals are animals made of tiny polyps.

quiz.question_zh: 考拉和袋鼠生活在哪个洲？
quiz.question_en: Which continent do koalas and kangaroos live on?
quiz.explain_zh: 考拉和袋鼠都是大洋洲特有的有袋类动物。
quiz.explain_en: Koalas and kangaroos are marsupials native to Oceania.

quiz.question_zh: 水豚和美洲豹生活在哪个洲？
quiz.question_en: Which continent do capybaras and jaguars live on?
quiz.explain_zh: 水豚和美洲豹都生活在南美的雨林和湿地。
quiz.explain_en: Capybaras and jaguars live in South American rainforests.

quiz.question_en: What do giant pandas mainly eat?
quiz.explain_zh: 大熊猫每天要吃很多竹子，但它其实是食肉目动物。
quiz.explain_en: Giant pandas eat mostly bamboo, though they belong to the order Carnivora.

quiz.question_zh: 非洲草原上跑得最快的动物是？
quiz.question_en: Which is the fastest animal on the African savanna?
quiz.explain_zh: 猎豹短跑可达每小时110公里，但只能坚持很短时间。
quiz.explain_en: Cheetahs can run up to 110 km/h in short bursts.

quiz.explain_zh: 鸭嘴兽和针鼹是单孔目动物，会下蛋但也是哺乳动物。
quiz.explain_en: Platypus and echidna are egg-laying mammals called monotremes.

quiz.question_zh: 下列哪种植物生活在南极地区？
quiz.question_en: Which plant lives in the Antarctic region?
quiz.explain_zh: 南极发草是南极仅有的两种开花植物之一。
quiz.explain_en: Antarctic hair grass is one of only two flowering plants in Antarctica.

quiz.explain_zh: 地衣是真菌和藻类一起生活的共生体，不算植物。
quiz.explain_en: Lichen is a symbiosis of fungi and algae, not a plant.

quiz.question_en: What is a koala's favorite food?
quiz.explain_zh: 考拉几乎只吃桉树叶，所以每天大部分时间在睡觉。
quiz.explain_en: Koalas eat almost only eucalyptus leaves.

quiz.explain_zh: 可可豆可以做成巧克力，原产于南美雨林。
quiz.explain_en: Cocoa beans come from the cacao tree, native to South America.
